_comment: Map of stop_id -> array of media entries. Photos are stored under /tour-data/media/{stop_id}/ as web-optimized JPEGs. Videos are either {type:'youtube', id:'...'} (long-form GoPro) or {type:'self_hosted', url:'media/{stop_id}/clip.mp4'} (short shared-album clips, already Apple-compressed to 720p).
